verdict.rationale: Ellis Porter's materials name H-1B, L-1, O-1, TN and "E" work visas, plus green-card routes (NIW, PERM, immigrant petitions). They also promise to help applicants, explicitly including founders, understand their options and choose a strategy. However, the temporary-visa coverage is framed for employers, and there is no founder-oriented guidance on picking between these paths. missing for 10: any mention of cap-exempt H-1B routes, explicit E-2 treeaty-investor coverage, founder-facing O-1/TN/E-2 content, detailed comparative guidance on choosing among visas, and EB-1 or other green-card paths beyond NIW/PERM.
